jd.title: IT Support Specialist (1st and 2nd Line)
jd.external_text:
Halvern Precision Components machines parts for the automotive and aerospace supply chain. Three shifts, two sites and around 380 staff who need their machines and their laptops working. This role is on-site by design: when a line stops because a terminal will not authenticate, someone has to walk to it.

What you'll do
- Handle 1st and 2nd line tickets across Windows 11 desktops, Microsoft 365 and our shop-floor terminals.
- Manage user accounts, group policy and the printer estate in Active Directory.
- Rebuild and deploy laptops and shop-floor PCs, and keep the asset register honest.
- Support production on the MES terminals: escalate to the vendor when it is the application, fix it yourself when it is not.
- Cover the 07:00 start on a rota with the rest of the IT department.

Requirements
- 2+ years in a hands-on IT support role.
- Active Directory and Microsoft 365 administration.
- Basic networking - you can tell a switch problem from a DHCP problem.
- Full UK driving licence. You will be at our second site in Nuneaton roughly one day a week.
- A team player with strong attention to detail.

Nice to have
- Manufacturing or warehouse environment experience.
- Any exposure to VMware or Hyper-V.
- ITIL foundation, or an interest in getting it.

You will report to the IT Manager. Coventry based, with the Nuneaton travel above.
